Description: Safety-relevant input process data sent from SRIO to the F_Host, including F-DI values, input status information, and qualifiers.
Reason for Protection: Incorrect or disclosed input data can cause unsafe control decisions, false safe states, or loss of process confidentiality.
Document Reference: 201 §3.1 Typical Usecase Example; 201 §5.3 State Operate, SRIO-10050, SRIO-10047; 209 §5.3.1.7 DI Elements

Description: Safety-relevant output process data and commanded F-DO states received from the F_Host and applied by SRIO to connected actuators, including output qualifiers.
Reason for Protection: Manipulated or unavailable output data can trigger unintended actuation or block required safety actions.
Document Reference: 201 §3.1 Typical Usecase Example; 201 §5.3 State Operate, SRIO-10049, SRIO-10046; 209 §5.3.1.8 DO Elements

Description: The PROFIsafe individual parameter sets for all 6 DI ports and 2 DO ports, including DI and DO safety parameters and their validated combinations.
Reason for Protection: These parameters define safety behavior of inputs and outputs; unauthorized change can alter the implemented safety function.
Document Reference: 100 §13.2 Safety Application Parameters; 100 SRIO-1983; 201 §8.6.4.2 Individual Parameter [iPar], SRIO-12574, SRIO-8573, SRIO-10813

Description: PROFIsafe communication parameters exchanged for SRIO, including F_Source_Add, F_WD_Time, F_iParCRC, and F_ParCRC.
Reason for Protection: These parameters establish safe communication integrity, timing, and parameter consistency; compromise can break or subvert the safety channel.
Document Reference: 100 §13.3 Safe Fieldbus Parameters; 209 §6.2.2 F-Parameters, Table 6; SRIO-7794; SRIO-1857

Description: The SRIO's own safe address used as the PROFIsafe destination address and derived from the rotary-switch setting for values 1..899.
Reason for Protection: This value anchors trusted addressing between safety communication partners; wrong or forged values enable misbinding or denial of safe communication.
Document Reference: 100 §13.4 Own Safe Address; 100 SRIO-2013; 201 SRIO-15799 and SRIO-11511; 209 §6.2.2, F_Dest_Add

Description: Communication configuration for the fieldbus side, including IP address, subnet mask, default gateway, DHCP/static mode, hostname, and NameOfStation-related settings.
Reason for Protection: Unauthorized changes can disrupt controller communication, misidentify the device on the network, or redirect operational traffic.
Document Reference: 209 §5.3.1.9 Fieldbussetup; /fieldbussetup/network/ipaddress, subnetmask, ipdefaultgateway, hostname, dhcp; §6.1.2 DCP, SRIO-7772, SRIO-3029, SRIO-3030

Description: Device identification and maintenance data, including product code/name, vendor, serial number, production date, hardware and software revision, and I&M0-I&M5 records.
Reason for Protection: These records support trusted identification, maintenance, asset management, and engineering; tampering can enable spoofing, misidentification, or unsafe maintenance actions.
Document Reference: 209 §5.3.1.2 Deviceinfo; §6.3 I&M Data; SRIO-2946; SRIO-3002; SRIO-3005; SRIO-3004; SRIO-3003; SRIO-3011; SRIO-3023

Description: The executable software baseline running on SRIO, including COM/SCPU firmware and exposed bootloader software versions for host and safety controllers.
Reason for Protection: Integrity and authenticity of installed executable software are required for trustworthy startup, communication, diagnostics, and safety behavior.
Document Reference: 100 SRIO-1268 Safe Firmware Architecture Characteristics; 209 §5.3.1.2 Deviceinfo, /deviceinfo/swrevision, /deviceinfo/swinfo/cpubootloaderversion, /deviceinfo/swinfo/scpuversion, /deviceinfo/swinfo/scpubootloaderversion

Description: The uploaded SRIO firmware package transported via IoTCore as a firmware container/blob for installation in update mode.
Reason for Protection: A forged or corrupted update package can replace trusted software or prevent safe operation; the update package therefore has clear integrity and authenticity value.
Document Reference: 209 §5.3.1.11 Firmware, /firmware/container, /firmware/install; 218 Chapter 9 Firmware Update, SRIO-15087, SRIO-9662

Description: Recorded error events, log entries, uptime context, and retained diagnostic history made available through IoT and fieldbus diagnosis handling.
Reason for Protection: These records are needed for incident analysis, fault handling, and service decisions; tampering or disclosure can mislead operators or hide failures.
Document Reference: 201 §8.1.2 IoTCore, SRIO-11532; 201 §8.1.4.1 Errorhandling, SRIO-10665, SRIO-10251; 209 §4.2.1 Error Logs, SRIO-15406, SRIO-10703, SRIO-10663, SRIO-10662, SRIO-15221

Description: Operational status and monitoring values exposed via IoTCore, including operating state, rotary-switch value, temperatures, voltages, currents, and related status indicators.
Reason for Protection: These values reveal internal state and support diagnostics and maintenance; tampering or unauthorized disclosure can mislead troubleshooting or leak operational insight.
Document Reference: 100 SRIO-1946; 201 §8.1.2 IoTCore, SRIO-11533; 209 §5.3.1.4 Devicestatus, /devicestatus/operatingstate, temperature, voltage, current

Description: Non-volatile stored data in EEPROM/NVMEM used to restore configuration and state after restart, including remanent I&M records and other saved device parameters.
Reason for Protection: Compromise of persistent data survives restart and can corrupt restored configuration, identity, or system behavior.
Document Reference: 100 SRIO-1258 EEPROM Layout; 100 §13.4 Own Safe Address; 209 §2.3.4.3 Device-Delegator; §2.3.4.4 NVMEM-Delegator; §6.3 I&M1/I&M2/I&M3 storage requirements

Description: The PROFINET GSDML device description file defining SRIO identity, modules, submodules, process-data lengths, F-parameter descriptors, and engineering-time configuration metadata.
Reason for Protection: Manipulated or unauthorized GSDML content can lead to unsafe or inconsistent engineering and configuration of the device.
Document Reference: 209 §6.2 GSD File; SRIO-3019; SRIO-3020; SRIO-3021; SRIO-3017; SRIO-7758; SRIO-6552; SRIO-14860
